BiblicalUsage: Meonothai is named once, in the genealogy of Judah, as the father of Ophrah. His grandsons were the craftsmen of the valley.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a single line in a genealogy is still a life: Meonothai raised a son whose sons were craftsmen, and the family trade is remembered alongside the name.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
